groups.A: saved original reference weighted max patch distance
groups.B: maximum of same raw nearest-neighbor patch distances, no weight
groups.C: mean of top K same raw patch distances, no weight

K_rule.justification: Average a small fixed upper tail to reduce isolated extreme sensitivity while limiting dilution; not selected by observed C performance.

known_prior_findings: A/B development rank diagnostic and specified boundary pair known before this design; K fixed before new C scores.
prohibited: No held-out image/GT/prediction reads. No test-guided scheme selection. No threshold or K search.
case_policy: Use manifest split membership only; held-out cases are N/A, not loaded. Analysis does not combine these cases with development metrics.
noise_analysis: For fixed K, compare dmax minus top11 mean (tail attenuation); use 8-connected components on >=C cutoff patch grid and top11 GT-cell overlap as diagnostics only. Do not change scoring or masks.
small_defect_analysis: Original GT union area <1%, already established group; report individual cases and coverage. No tiny-defect generalization claim.
